mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( user_id, operation, method, target, create_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{target}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM operation_log ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM operation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM operation_log WHERE operation = #{operation} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM operation_log WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY create_time DESC
